scientific_limitations: The exact values apply to the specified two-transition compact binary shift after identifying its two constant points, not arbitrary full-chain-recurrent homeomorphisms.
Only ordinary singleton-collapsed symmetric-product suspensions are considered; no claim is made for quotients collapsing larger finite-set strata.
The entire nonwandering and chain recurrent sets of the source system are established in the motivating paper, not reproved as novel results.
No claim is made for the exact topological entropy of the full hyperspace or exact finite-horizon separated-set counts.
title: Exact polynomial-entropy hierarchy for a full-chain-recurrent symmetric-product counterexample
